ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: All speakers were confident, comfortable with being seen.
ex.t: 后来有一天，我在一个大型会议上，突然像闪电一样受到了启发。

ex.s: With all the programs, teamwork is key as trainees learn the importance of leadership and being part of a bigger task.
ex.t: 在所有项目中，团队合作是关键，学员从中学习领导力和成为更大任务一部分的重要性。

ex.s: Today Pacific Science Center serves more than 1.3 million people a year and beings inquiry-based science education to classrooms and community events all over Washington State.
ex.t: 今天,太平洋科学中心每年为130多万人提供服务,为华盛顿州各地的教室和社区活动提供以调查为基础的科学教育。

ex.s: Scientists have found that all kinds of plants give out VOCs when being attacked.
ex.t: 科学家发现，各种植物在受到攻击时都会释放VOCs。

ex.s: Scientists have found that all kinds of plants give out VOCs when being attacked .It’s a plant’s way of crying out.But is anyone listening?Apparently.Because we can watch the neighbors react.
ex.t: 科学家发现，各种植物在受到攻击时都会释放VOCs。这是植物在呼救。但有人听吗？显然有，因为我们可以看到邻近的植物做出反应。
